Open items (also stated wherever the affected number appears)

  • Per-model cacheable minimums not yet simulated → 34.0% may overstate on some models.
  • Anthropic batch rate uncatalogued → async figures OpenAI-priced; Anthropic batch events are correctly *unpriced*, never zeroed.
  • Package freshness gate and automated CJS smoke not yet in the build script (the CJS tarball was smoke-tested manually at 4e51734).
  • The banded figures are simulator-measured. A first real-traffic export exists (30 requests, see the table) and found one lever losing money on one-shot traffic — fixed at ec191c5 and re-verified. The bands stay simulator-labelled until a pilot-scale export replaces them.

  • archestra.ai — progressive disclosure: ~77% modelled vs ~13% measured.
  • RouterArena (arXiv:2510.00202) — independent router leaderboard.
